scope: Exploratory retrospective calibration extension, after inspecting the initial grid; not an independent confirmatory test.
reason: Compressing the unmeasured release lag to 0.75 or 0.5 worsened both administrator-shuttle queue constraints. Test the opposite timing direction without changing demand quantities or shuttle clocks.
objective: Mean of uniform-minute expected absolute distance to observed count/interval divided by observation midpoint, over the three direction-confirmed reports.
selection: Prefer minimum primary loss among internally feasible candidates; retain alpha1 control and parent as references. Ties prefer closer to1. All weekday by regular/peak10 conditions required before recommendation. Report individual regressions and whole-journey tails.
constraints: No demand thinning or capacity inflation
No queue clipping or forced20minute exits
identification_limit: Effective release timing is confounded with unmeasured immediate trip share, mode/destination mixture and nominal shuttle phase. Alpha is not a measurement of actual building egress.
